text:
maria: Quick idea — thread to map a welcome-sequence velocity play for the next launch. goal: faster first-success with low friction (credits + 1-click prompt pack + webinar invite). testing plan: 3 nudge cadences over 72h. comments?
ashley: love it. can we make one path focused on embedding demos (low CPU) vs. generation demos (higher cost)?
jon: yep, segment by likely product fit signal from signup form. signal idea: 'uses-llm-for' field -> map to template set.
sam: timeline/ops question — who owns the prompt-pack content? Content team or devex?
maria: devex owns shells, content team reviews persona copy. i'll own orchestration + experiment metrics.
ashley: pragmatic metric: % who hit 1st useful response within 24h, and cost per activated user. target: 40% and < $0.50 token-cost per activation.
maria: proposed cadence (draft):
```
0h: welcome email + 25 free credits + 1-click "try starter prompt pack" CTA
6h: in-app nudge with 3 curated templates (embedding/generation/rewrite)
24h: targeted invite to 30-min demo webinar + live qa
48h: final credit reminder + quick tips + invite replay
```
jon: suggestion: use routing rules so embedding-heavy users go to the embedding starter template and see a short demo video (30s). reduces cost and demonstrates value fast.
ashley: subject line variants — short list: "Your Redwood starter credits — 25 on us", "Start building with 25 free tokens", "Try these 3 prompts (works in 60s)". A/B test top 2.
sam: ops: need a concise rollout checklist. i can own infra hooks (route flags, quotas). maria can add copy + metric events.
maria: checklist snippet for growth ops: 
- create experiment flag: welcome_velocity_v3
- wire email templates (v3a/v3b)
- wire in-app nudge content + deck link
- assign webhook to log activation_event
- add model routing: default -> cost-optimized gen, fallback -> small-embeds model

growth-bot: experiment created: welcome_velocity_v3 (id: exp_20250321_7). traffic: 10% initial, ramp to 40% if no regression in 72h.
ashley: training note for webinar: 15m product demo + 10m quick prompt-walkthrough + 5m q&a. record and add clip for follow-up email.
jon: for prompt templates, keep 1 exemplar per persona + 2 variations. store in PromptPack v2 (immutable).
maria: activation event tracking (event names): "welcome_clicked", "prompt_pack_used", "first_success", "webinar_registered". pls ensure analytics pipeline tags model_name + route_variant.
sam: ops question: default quotas for new users — are we lowering token-per-minute to protect infra?
maria: start conservative: 60rpm, 5k/day. tune for cohorts.
ashley: quick UX ask — add a microcopy under CTA: "25 credits expire in 7 days". increases urgency. short test.
maria: timeline: draft templates by EOD Wed, infra hooks Thurs, soft launch Friday 10% traffic. report at Mon sync.
jon: approved. i'll prepare the seg mapping rules.
ashley: I'll own subject line A/B, creative assets, and webinar landing page copy.
sam: i'll set rollout pipeline and monitor throttles. set alert if avg latency > 2s for starter prompts.
maria: awesome. last note — keep prompt packs tiny (3 prompts) and include a 'seed input' example for fastest activation.
ashley: :rocket:
maria: thanks all — i'll drop the template drafts into this thread and tag for review.
